## Marble Burying Test

-- **Illustration:**  
Boxplots and individual scores  

```{r data_loading}

rm(list = ls())

#--------------------------- 1. Manual Entries -----------------------------#
# 1.1 INPUT FILES
file_path <- "~/AOCF-Behavioral Tests/Marble Burying test/validation/group data/"

raw_data_file <- "marble burying_group data.xlsx"

#---------------------------2. LOAD DATA-----------------------------#
# Load data
raw_data <- read_excel(paste(file_path,raw_data_file,sep = ""))
raw_data <- na.omit(raw_data)

#get list of strains without NAs
list_of_genotypes <- sort(na.omit(unique(raw_data$genotype)), decreasing = T)
 
# Factor the genotype/group/sex variable 
data <- raw_data %>%
  mutate(genotype = as.factor(genotype),
         gr = as.factor(group),
         sex = as.factor(sex))  
  
```

### Experimental conditions

3 groups of mice:

LOG DATA: _No Crash of the system, all data can be used_

-> all data can be used    

Path to all Raw data files: `AOCF-Behavioral Tests\Marble Burying test\validation\group data`  

Preprocessed Data: 
 
3 groups:  

`marble burying_group data.xlsx`

The analysis of the data is done in this Rmd file directly.  

Path to Report: `AOCF-Behavioral Tests\Marble Burying test\validation\group data`    

### Data Quality:  
->All data can be used.  

\newpage 

### Results

#### Latency to burry first marble

```{r pl_lat, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 9}

#---------------------------3. ANALYSIS-----------------------------#
# 3.1 Marble burying test 
# 3.1.1 Latency between groups

pl_lat <- data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = gr, y = `latency [sec]`, color = gr, label ="")) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NULL) +
  #add data-points (not overlapping)
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.75), size = 2) +
  #define position of 'n='
  stat_n_text(y.pos = 5) +
  #axis title
  labs(x="", 
       y = "Time (s)",  
       title = "Latency to bury first marble") +
  #add a theme
  theme_pubr() + 
  #legend
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12))

#pl_lat  

pl_lat_s <- data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = gr, y = `latency [sec]`, color = sex, label ="")) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NULL) +
  #add data-points (not overlapping)
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.75), size = 2) +
  #define position of 'n='
  stat_n_text(y.pos = 5) +
  #count n of each gender and add it to the plot  
  geom_text(aes(label=..count.., y = ..count..), stat="count", position = position_dodge(width = 0.95), size=4) +
  #axis title
  labs(x="", 
       y = "Time (s)",  
       title = "Latency to bury first marble") +
  #add a theme
  theme_pubr() +
  #legend
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12))

#pl_lat_s
  
#arrange the 2 plots created above into a grid with 1 rows and 2 column with automatic labelling (A,B)
Fig1 <- ggarrange(pl_lat, pl_lat_s, labels="AUTO", ncol=1, nrow=2, common.legend=F, legend = "bottom")

Fig1

```

__Figure 1.__ Comparison of latency to burry first marble between groups (A) and between gender within group (B). 

\newpage

__Statistics for Figure 1 A.__

```{r fig1a stats}

# Stats for Figure 1 (COMPARISON BETWEEN GROUPS)
#create a tibble to collect all stats
stats = tibble()

stat_data <- pl_lat$data

# perform Pairwise Wilcoxon Rank Sum Tests to compare within genotpye difference
st = tidy(pairwise.wilcox.test(stat_data$`latency [sec]`, stat_data$gr, exact = FALSE, p.adjust.methods="BH")) %>%
    mutate(method = "Pairwise Wilcoxon Sum",
          variable = "Fig 1 A, latency",
          test = paste("between groups"), 
          sign=ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "*", ""))

#combine stats from every iteration of the loop
stats = bind_rows(stats, st)

#format the table
stats%>%
  #remove horizontal lines between rows
  kable(booktabs = T) %>%
  #prevent table from floating and scale it to page-width
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position","scale_down"))

```

__Statistics for Figure 1 B. (Between genders)__

```{r fig1b1 stats}

# Stats for Figure 1 (COMPARISON BETWEEN GENDERS)
# list of gender
list_of_genders <- as.factor(c("f", "m"))

# list of groups
list_of_groups <- as.factor(c("1", "2", "3"))

#create a tibble to collect all stats
stats = tibble()

for (i in 1:length(list_of_groups)) {
  stat_data <- pl_lat_s$data %>%
    filter(gr == list_of_groups[i])
    # perform Wilcoxon Rank Sum Tests to compare within group difference
 st = tidy(wilcox.test(stat_data$`latency [sec]` ~ stat_data$sex, exact = FALSE)) %>%
    mutate(method = "Wilcoxon Sum",
          variable = "Fig 1 B, latency",
          test = paste("between genders in group", list_of_groups[i]), 
          sign=ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "*", "")) #%>%
  #combine stats from every iteration of the loop
  stats = bind_rows(stats, st)
 }

#format the table
stats%>%
  #remove horizontal lines between rows
  kable(booktabs = T) %>%
  #prevent table from floating and scale it to page-width
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position","scale_down"))

```

__Statistics for Figure 1 B. (Between groups)__

```{r fig1b2 stats}

# Stats for Figure 1 (COMPARISON BETWEEN GROUPS)
#create a tibble to collect all stats
stats = tibble()

for (i in 1:length(list_of_genders)) {
  stat_data <- pl_lat_s$data %>%
    filter(sex == list_of_genders[i])
  # perform Pairwise Wilcoxon Rank Sum Tests to compare between group difference
  st = tidy(pairwise.wilcox.test(stat_data$`latency [sec]`, stat_data$gr, exact = FALSE, p.adjust.methods="BH")) %>%

          test = paste("between groups for", list_of_genders[i]), 
          sign=ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "*", "")) #%>%
  #combine stats from every iteration of the loop
  stats = bind_rows(stats, st)
 }

#format the table
stats%>%
```

#### Number of marbles burried

```{r pl_no, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 9}

#---------------------------3. ANALYSIS-----------------------------#
# 3.1.2 Number of marbles burried

  ggplot(aes(x = gr, y = `buried marbles`, color = gr, label ="")) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NULL) +
  #add data-points (not overlapping)
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.75), size = 2) +
  #define position of 'n='
  stat_n_text(y.pos = 5) +
  #axis title
  labs(x="", 
       y = "no.",  
       title = "Number of buried marbles") +
  #add a theme
  theme_pubr() + 
  #legend
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12))

#pl_no  

pl_no_s <- data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = gr, y = `buried marbles`, color = sex, label ="")) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NULL) +
  #add data-points (not overlapping)
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.75), size = 2) +
  #define position of 'n='
  stat_n_text(y.pos = 5) +
  #count n of each gender and add it to the plot  
  geom_text(aes(label=..count.., y = ..count..), stat="count", position = position_dodge(width = 0.95), size=4) +
  #axis title
  labs(x="", 
       y = "no.",  
       title = "Number of buried marbles") +
  #add a theme
  theme_pubr() +
  #legend
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",

#pl_no_s
  
#arrange the 2 plots created above into a grid with 1 rows and 2 column with automatic labelling (A,B)
Fig2 <- ggarrange(pl_no, pl_no_s, labels="AUTO", ncol=1, nrow=2, common.legend=F, legend = "bottom")

Fig2

```

__Figure 2.__ Comparison of number of marbles burried between groups (A) and between gender within group (B).
